evidence.proposition: SK hynix states that HBM yields fewer usable dies per wafer than conventional DRAM because TSV increases die size, requiring more wafers for the same memory capacity; chip stacking and packaging further increase manufacturing complexity.
SK hynix reports a 31% productivity improvement in previously bottlenecked HBM processes and a 21% yield improvement.
SK hynix reports that the manufacturing improvements significantly contributed to a 4.5-fold increase in HBM sales in 2024 versus the prior year.
SK hynix reported all-time-high quarterly revenue and operating profit following brisk AI-memory sales and expanded sales of 12-high HBM3E.
SK hynix displayed its 36GB 12-layer HBM3E installed in NVIDIA's GB200 GPU module for AI servers.
Samsung Global Newsroom published the March 18 2026 Samsung-AMD AI-memory collaboration announcement.
Samsung Newsroom Korea published the Korean-language version of the same March 18 2026 Samsung-AMD collaboration event.
